newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMPELLA PROPOSES NAME SWITCH TO TAMROCK.
newsitem.headline: TAMPELLA PROPOSES NAME SWITCH TO TAMROCK.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Tampella Oy said in a statement on Tuesday its board was proposing that the company be renamed Tamrock Oy.
"Tampella's board has decided to call an extraordinary shareholders' meeting to decide about a change of the company's name to Tamrock Oy," Tampella said.
Mining equipment maker Tamrock is Tampella's biggest business group. Tamrock's January-August net sales at 2.27 billion markka accounted for nearly 80 percent of Tampella's net sales.
The extraordinary shareholders' meeting will be held on December 9, Tampella said. The new name, Tamrock, can be taken into use once it has been approved by two shareholders' meetings.
Tampella's intention is to see the name switch take effect early in 1997 at the same time when Tamrock according to an earlier decision will be merged with Tampella.
